To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the proposed sampling mechanism can more accurately estimate the query performance in domain-specific corporas, (ii) the entropy-based measures can accurately predict query performance in domain specific corporas, and (iii) the proposed technique can improve query performance by applying selective query expansion.

(a) the performance of information-entropy-based prediction techniques is highly dependent on the quality of the query model; (b) a simple sampling technique that we propose can improve query modeling in the context of a domain-specific corpus; and (c) the performance of the information-entropy-based techniques is highly dependent of the size of the domain-specific corpus.

(1) the performance of the query can be predicted with a high degree of accuracy using the proposed sampling mechanism, and (2) the proposed sampling mechanism outperforms existing sampling techniques for estimating query models in domain- specific corpora.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions.
the problem of identifying and predicting the performance of queries in domain-specific corporas.
the problem of predicting performance of a given query in domain-specific corporas.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed method is effective in predicting performance of a given query in a given domain-specific corpus.
our technique is able to predict query performance with a reasonable level of accuracy.

the proposed sampling mechanism is able to deliver accurate predictions in all the domain-specific corpora studied, and is especially effective in predicting queries that are likely to have a low recall.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our technique can be used to predict the effectiveness of a query and hence can be used for identifying ineffective queries.
we have proposed a novel sampling mechanism that can be used to accurately predict query performance and can help identify ineffective and effective queries.
our sampling mechanism is able to improve the performance of the query performance prediction in domain-specific corporas.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of a query can be predicted using entropy measures and that this prediction can be used to improve the performance of document recommender systems.
the proposed method can accurately predict the performance of a given query and can be used to identify ineffective queries in domain-specific corporas.
, in the context of a domain-specific corpora, information-entropy-based metrics can be used to accurately predict the performance of a given query.
